book.name: Luku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ LUKU U YORUA

content: Setɑm u Yesu kɔkurɑ
Yesu u Hunde Dɛɛro yibɑ mɑ u wurɑmɑ Yuudɛnin di. Mɑ Hunde wi, u nùn sure ɡbɑburu sɔɔ.
Miyɑ Setɑm mɑɑ nùn kɔkurɑ sɔ̃ɔ weeru. U ǹ mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu di sɑnɑm mɛ sɔɔ. Ye sɑɑ yen bɑɑ yɑ kpɑ, ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ nùn mwɑ.
Mɑ Setɑm nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n Gusunɔn Biin nɑ, ɑ kpee teni sɔ̃ɔwɔ tu ɡɔsirɑ pɛ̃ɛ.
Mɑ Yesu nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ yoruɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri sɔɔ bɑ nɛɛ, “Tɔnu kun ko n wɑ̃ɑ dĩɑnu tɔnɑn sɔ̃.”
Mɑ Setɑm u kɑ nùn dɑ ɡuuru wɔllɔ u nùn hɑnduniɑn tem kpuro sɔ̃ɔsi nɔni kpɑki teeru mi sinɑmbɑ bɑndu dii.
Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nin dɑm kɑ nin yiiko kpurowɑ kon nun wɛ̃ domi bɑ mɑn wɛ̃. Wi nɑ kĩ, wiyɑ kon mɑɑ wɛ̃.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ̀ n yiirɑ ɑ mɑn sɑ̃wɑ ye kpurowɑ yɑ koo ko wunɛɡiɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔn ɡɑri nɛɛ, “Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinniwɑ kɑɑ n sɑ̃ɑmɔ, kpɑ ɑ n wi turon wɑ̃ɑru wɑ̃ɑ.”
Mɑ u kɑ nùn dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, u nùn sɔndi sɑ̃ɑ yerun wii kpiirɔ, mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n Gusunɔn Biin nɑ, ɑ suro sɑɑ minin di,
domi Gusunɔn ɡɑri nɛɛ, “U koo win ɡɔrɑdobɑ nɔɔ kɛ̃wɑ wunɛn sɔ̃ bu kɑ nun kɔ̃su.”
“Bɑ koo nun nɛnɛ ben nɔmɑ sɔɔ, kpɑ wunɛn nɑɑsu ku rɑɑ kperu sokurɑ.”
Yesu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔn ɡɑri mɑɑ nɛɛ, “A ku rɑ Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinnin dɑm mɛɛri ɑ kɑ wɑ mɛ mu nɛ.”
Ye Setɑm u nùn kɔkiri bi kpuro kuɑ u kpɑ, u nùn deri u doonɑ sere sɑɑ ɡɑɑ ɡinɑ.
Yesu win sɔmburu toruɑ Gɑlileɔ
Yesu u wurɑ Gɑlileɔ kɑ Gusunɔn Hunden dɑm, mɑ win lɑbɑɑri yɑ nɔɔrɑ n kɑ sikerenɑ berɑ ye sɔɔ kpuro.
U Gusunɔn ɡɑrin keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ ben mɛnnɔ yenu sɔɔ, mɑ tɔmbu kpuro bɑ nùn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ.
Bɑ Yesu yinɑ Nɑsɑrɛtiɔ
Yesu u dɑ Nɑsɑrɛtiɔ mi u biru di. Nɡe mɛ win dɔɔnɛ u mɛnnɔ yeru duɑ tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ, mɑ u seewɑ u kɑ tireru ɡɑri.
Bɑ nùn Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Esɑin tireru wɛ̃. Ye u tu wukiɑ u wɑ mi bɑ yoruɑ bɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: U mɑn ɡɔsɑ n kɑ dɑm sɑriruɡibu Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ nɔɔsiɑ.
U mɑn ɡɔrimɑ n kɑ yobu sɔ̃ mɑ bɑ koo yɑkiɑrɑ,
n kɑ wɔ̃kobu sɔ̃ mɑ bɑ koo yɑm wɑ,
n kɑ mɑɑ tɑkɑsiɡibu yɔ̃su bu doonɑ,
kpɑ n mɑɑ kɑ kpɑrɑ mɑ sɑɑ yɑ wee yè sɔɔ Yinni u koo tɔmbu durom kuɑ.”

content: U tire te wukiri u mɛnnɔ yerun sɔmɔ wesiɑ mɑ u sinɑ. Be bɑ mɛnnɛ mɛnnɔ yee te sɔɔ, bɑ nùn nɔni ɡirɑri be kpuro.
Mɑ u win ɡɑri toruɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡisɔrɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri yini yi koorɑ yi i nuɑ mi.
Be kpuro bɑ nùn seedɑ ɡeɑ diiyɑ, mɑ biti yɑ bu mwɑ ɡɑri dure yin sɔ̃ yi yi yɑrimɔ win nɔɔn di. Mɑ bɑ mɔ̀, n ǹ Yosɛfun bii wi mi?
U bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡem, i ko kpĩ i mɑn mɔn te kuɑ i nɛɛ, “Timɡii, ɑ wunɛn tii bɛkio,” kpɑ i ɡere n koowo nɛn tem sɔɔ mini ye i nuɑ nɑ kuɑ kpuro Kɑpenɑmuɔ.
U mɑɑ nɛɛ, kɑ ɡem, nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, Gusunɔn sɔmɔ ɡoo sɑri wi u bɛɛrɛ mɔ win tiin temɔ.
Nɑ mɑɑ bɛɛ ɡem sɔ̃ɔmɔ, kurɔ ɡɔmini dɑbirɑ tɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ Isirelin temɔ Elin wɑɑti, ye ɡurɑ kun nɑ wɔ̃ɔ itɑ kɑ suru nɔɔbɑ tiɑ, mɑ ɡɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru tɑ kuɑ tem kpuro.
Kɑ mɛ, bɑ ǹ Eli ɡɔre ben ɡoon mi mɑ n kun mɔ ɡɔmini turo wi u wɑ̃ɑ Sɑrepɑtɑɔ Sidonin temɔ.
Dɑbiru be bɑ bɑrɑ disiɡiru mɔ bɑ rɑɑ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ Isirelin temɔ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Eliseen wɑɑti. Kɑ mɛ, bɑ ǹ ben ɡoo bɛkie, mɑ n kun mɔ Nɑmɑni Siriɡii.
Ye bɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ mɛnnɔ yee te sɔɔ, bɑ mɔru bɛsirɑ be kpuro.
N deemɑ ben wuu ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡuuru wɔllɔ. Yerɑ bɑ seewɑ bɑ nùn bɔrikiɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ wuun biruɔ bu kɑ nùn sure wɔwɑ sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ u bu bukiɑnɑ mɑ u doonɑ.
Durɔ wi wɛrɛku ɡɑɡu ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑsi
Yesu u sɑrɑ u dɑ Kɑpenɑmuɔ, Gɑlilen wuu ɡɑɡɔ, mɑ u tɔmbu Gusunɔn ɡɑrin keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ.
Mɑ win sɔ̃ɔsirɑ bu biti kuɑ domi u ɡɑri ɡerumɔwɑ kɑ yiiko.
N deemɑ durɔ ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ mɛnnɔ yeru sɔɔ wì sɔɔ wɛrɛku ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ mɑ u wurɑ kuɑ wɔllɔ u nɛɛ,
mɑn diyɑ bɛsɛ kɑ wunɛ, Yesu Nɑsɑrɛtiɡii. A nɑ ɑ sun kɑm koosiɑwɑ? Nɑ yɛ̃ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ, wunɛ Gusunɔn tɔn Dɛɛrowɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u ɡu ɡerusi u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑrio, kpɑ ɑ doonɑ win min di. Ye wɛrɛku ɡe, ɡɑ durɔ wi tem kpɑrɑnɑ ben suunu sɔɔ, mɑ ɡɑ doonɑ, ɡɑ ǹ mɑɑ nùn mɛɛrɑ kue.
Mɑ biti yɑ bu mwɑ kpuro bɑ bikiɑnɑmɔ bɑ mɔ̀, ɡɑri yiren bweserɑ yini. Domi u wɛrɛkunu woodɑ wɛ̃ɛmɔ kɑ yiiko kɑ dɑm, mɑ nu doonɑmɔ.
Mɑ win lɑbɑɑri yɑ nɔɔrɑ n kɑ sikerenɑ berɑ ye sɔɔ kpuro.
Yesu u tɔn dɑbinu bɛkiɑ
Ye Yesu u yɑrɑ mɛnnɔ yee ten min di u duɑ Simɔɔn yɛnuɔ. N deemɑ Simɔɔn kurɔn mɛro u wɑsi sundu bɑrɔ tɑ bɔɔbu, mɑ bɑ nùn suuru kɑnɑ win sɔ̃.
U kurɔ wi tuke u wɑsi sun te ɡerusi mɑ tɑ nùn deri. U seewɑ yɑnde u bu nɔɔrimɔ.
Ye sɔ̃ɔ duɔ, bèn tɔmbɑ bɑrɑ bwese bwesekɑ mɔ kpuro bɑ kɑ bu nɑ win mi, mɑ u ben bɑɑwure nɔmɑ sɔndi u bu bɛkiɑ.
Wɛrɛkunu mɑɑ doonɑ tɔn dɑbirun min di, nu wuri mɔ̀ nu mɔ̀, wunɑ Gusunɔn Bii. Adɑmɑ u nu ɡerusi, u ǹ mɑɑ dere nu ɡɑri ɡere yèn sɔ̃ nu yɛ̃ mɑ Kirisiwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ.
Yesun wɑɑsu Yudeɑɔ
Ye yɑm sɑ̃rɑ Yesu u seewɑ u wuu yɑrɑ u dɑ ɡbɑburɔ. Adɑmɑ tɔn wɔru ɡɑ nùn kɑsu. Ye bɑ turɑ win mi, bɑ nùn suuru kɑnɑ u ku bu deri.
Adɑmɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, u ǹ koo ko u kun mɑɑ Gusunɔn bɑndun Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ wɑɑsu kue wusu ɡɑsu sɔɔ, domi yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ nùn ɡɔrimɑ.
Mɑ u wɑɑsu mɔ̀ Gɑlilen mɛnnɔ yenu sɔɔ.
